thread:
maya_cs: Heads-up — we need to send affected onboarding tenants a concise status + mitigation note. Root cause looks like the webhook rate limiter + stale retry logic interacting with a midnight batch window. Planning a targeted email, in-app banner for affected orgs, and an offer for assisted onboarding. Draft below for review.

ben_eng: Can we confirm no PII was exposed and include exact times for the retry backlog? Also, can the email include the technical fix at a high level?

liam_sre: Confirmed — no PII. Timeline: retry backlog started 2026-02-14T00:12Z, peaked ~00:38Z, and drained by ~06:10Z after manual throttles were adjusted. Root cause: token-bucket refill calc errored during DST transition in our batch window; retry logic re-enqueued callbacks without backoff. Patch queued and released.

maya_cs: For comms we'll offer a one-week onboarding assist + a $200 account credit for impacted seats. We should mark any renewal-risk accounts and escalate. Draft email copy below — please react or suggest edits.

ashley_csm: Uploading the list of affected tenants to the secure drive now and will DM access to legal. Can we get a 2-line blurb for legal to OK?

ben_eng: Short blurb for legal: "We experienced delayed delivery of webhook callbacks during a scheduled system change which temporarily impacted some onboarding flows. We have fixed the retry logic, validated data integrity, and implemented monitoring to prevent recurrence."

deploy-bot: deploy 3.14.7 -> prod succeeded at 2026-02-14T07:12Z :shipit:

maya_cs: Draft email (subject + body):

Subject: Update: Short delay in onboarding webhooks — impact & next steps

Hi [Name],

We’re reaching out because we detected a delay that affected webhook callbacks for some onboarding flows between 00:12Z–06:10Z on Feb 14. This may have caused onboarding steps to stall or retries to appear in your queue. We have fixed the underlying retry logic, confirmed no customer data was exposed, and drained the backlog.

What we’re doing: we patched the retry/refill logic, added alerts for retry-backlog growth, and will run a postmortem.

What we’re offering: one-week hands-on onboarding assistance and a $200 account credit for affected seats. Reply here or open a support ticket and we’ll prioritize.

We’re sorry for the disruption and appreciate your patience.

— The Redwood Inference Team

ashley_csm: :thumbsup: Wording looks good. I'll route to legal with that blurb and ask for a quick OK.

liam_sre: Observability changes: added metric for token-bucket refill correctness and an alert if retry-backlog > 1k across a region. Postmortem scheduled 2026-02-15 10:00 PT.

maya_cs: Plan: 1) send targeted email in ~1 hour once legal signs off, 2) post in-app banner to affected orgs, 3) open prioritized support tickets for renewal-risk accounts and offer office hours. I'll coordinate the credits and assist bookings.

customer-ops: Noted — I'll prep the support queue and add priority tags. Please DM the tenant list once it's ready so I can assign reps.

maya_cs: Thanks all — please react to the thread when you’ve actioned your item. I’ll update after legal sign-off and after the first batch of emails goes out. :eyes:
